summary.tldr: Removes GST from carbon pollution pricing charges and adds emission allowances to the GST zero-rated list.
what_it_does: Excludes taxes, duties and fees under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act from the amount used to calculate GST.
Excludes provincial levies imposed in respect of carbon from the GST base.
Repeals two GST rules that deal with carbon pricing.
Adds supplies of emission allowances to Schedule VI of the Excise Tax Act, which zero-rates them for GST.
Brings the bill into force 45 days after royal assent.
who_it_affects: People and businesses paying carbon pricing
